thread:
Lina (PM): Quick sync on private deploy asks. Field top three: preserve customer egress IPs, smaller airgap installer, and customer-managed KMS/HSM. Need a prioritized roadmap and launch gates.
Omar (Solutions): Two customers also asked for predictable DNS addresses (no ephemeral hostnames) and cert pinning for outbound callbacks. Those are gating for them.
Priya (SRE): Preserving egress IPs has three paths: relay (Redwood proxy), host SNAT + static IPs, or BGP/peering. Relay is fastest but not acceptable for some regulated customers.
Tom (Infra Eng): Technical notes: operator-based BGP shim will need NET_ADMIN and iproute2 in the bundle. Host SNAT requires kernel sysctl changes we cannot do from non-priv pods. BGP peering => node-level hooks.
Zoe (Security): KMS/HSM: customers expect never-exportable keys and attestation. We need a threat model doc and an HSM test harness. Also require least-privilege for any operator shim.
Lina (PM): Proposal: 1) Spike (2 sprints) to prototype operator shim + preflight checks, 2) Ship improved offline installer (slim) for relay mode, 3) KMS/HSM integration milestone after spike. Launch gate = successful enterprise canary + signed field acceptance.
Omar (Solutions): Sales needs packaging matrix: Basic (relay, self-serve), Advanced (static IPs via operator shim, paid), Enterprise (on-prem BGP + HSM). Need messaging for SLAs and rollback story.
Priya (SRE): From SRE standpoint add acceptance tests: ip-preserve smoke for three topologies (NAT, NAT64, direct peering), installer validation on airgapped subnet, telemetry opt-out verified. Also ensure autoscale behaviour doesn't break when hostNetwork=true.
Tom (Infra Eng): Agree. Spike checklist: prototype operator shim that announces a loopback via BGP, integration test that flips `net.ipv4.ip_forward`, and a preflight script sample: `./preflight --check-egress --expected-ip 1.2.3.4`.
Zoe (Security): Add security gates: threat model signoff, privileged container review, KMS credential flow documented, and HSM test with PKCS#11 integration.
Priya (SRE): Also flag monitoring: customers want token-level cost breakdown off by default in private mode. Need a test to confirm no outbound metering calls in airgapped installs.
ci-bot: CI: private-operator-spike pipeline started at 4198765475 :gear:
Lina (PM): Suggested launch acceptance criteria (initial GA): 1) Egress IP preserved in 3 canonical topologies + smoke tests passing; 2) Airgap installer <= 190MB with relay package; 3) KMS integration tests pass (rotation + access revocation); 4) Rollback documented and verified <10m to relay fallback; 5) Security review complete.
Tom (Infra Eng): Risk notes: BGP path increases attack surface and may impact kernel networking settings. We'll add an explicit upgrade path doc and a rollback playbook (iptables restore + disable shim).
Omar (Solutions): I'll map customers to tiers and collect written acceptance criteria from the 3 pilot accounts.
Lina (PM): Prioritization vote: Spike (must do), Airgap-slim (parallel), KMS/HSM (follow). If no objections I'll mark spike as top priority.
Zoe (Security): +1 but please include compliance checklist for regulated industries.
Priya (SRE): +1. I'll draft the test matrix and automation for the smoke tests.
Tom (Infra Eng): I'll lead the spike and deliver a PRD + prototype. Estimate: 2 sprints for prototype, then backlog grooming.
Lina (PM): Action items: Tom -> PRD + prototype branch by next Tue; Priya -> test matrix draft; Omar -> customer acceptance docs; Zoe -> security gate checklist. Reconvene next Tue 10am. :calendar: 
Omar (Solutions): Noted, will ping customers today.
ci-bot: Deployment: private-operator-spike -> staging at 4198765480 :rocket:
Lina (PM): Thanks all. Keep thread for artifacts (PRD, preflight script, test matrix).
